d.finding: PersistentRuntimeService is START_STICKY and unconditionally publishes READY/controller-running, but the real controller is FoldOverlayService. Accessibility teardown destroys that controller without stopping/downgrading the FGS, and sticky recreation can publish READY before onServiceConnected. READY therefore is not owned by a live controller.
d.recommendedContract: Epoch-owned liveness using existing FoldOverlayService.serviceEpoch: READY only with current attached epoch; ownerless+accessibility-enabled is RECOVERING; accessibility-disabled is STOPPED/self-stop. Ignore stale detach for old epochs. Keep START_STICKY if desired; do not use enabled-state alone as READY proof.
integrationNotes: Remove duplicate PersistentRuntimeService.ensureRunning(this) in FoldOverlayService.onServiceConnected() while touching boundary.
Add runtime-liveness diagnostics including state, ownerEpoch, enabled-state, reason.
Hardware is not required to prove ownership mismatch; Fold7 field test only measures recovery timing/user-visible severity.
d.reviewRequest: Manager/reviewer validate the epoch-owned liveness contract and route to primary if accepted.
